displayName: OCI-PCI-013: PCI-DSS — Physical Access to CDE Without Badge
description:
Detects physical access to cardholder data environment without proper badge or authorization

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: pci-dss — physical access to cde without badge

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_pci_013", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%pci%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%dss%') AND "value" > 0
